name: Assumption and Precondition Audit
purpose: Audit every theorem candidate for hidden assumptions, undeclared spaces, missing equivalence relations, and implicit closure claims.

audit_requirements.definition: Verify all core variables used in the proof are mapped to defined state spaces in state_space_registry.json.
Verify all admissibility sets and boundaries are mapped to definitions in admissibility_space_registry.json.
Verify all equivalence (~, ≅) or compatibility relations are mapped to equivalence_relation_registry.json.
Verify all operator applications satisfy signatures in operator_signature_hardening_registry.json.
Verify that proof failure modes are recorded as first-class objects in formal_failure_condition_registry.json.
Confirm that no assumption (e.g., 'for all x') extends beyond the local neighborhood restricted domain.
Ensure that equivalence relations are not treated as identity (=) or ontological sameness.

governance_rules.rule: Every proof candidate must pass the full assumption audit before proceeding to review.
Audit failures must be preserved as structural information and tracked until formal resolution.

forbidden_claims: A clean audit proves the theorem is correct.
Hidden globality is admissible if the theorem 'feels' universal.
